summary: Reviewed all requested criteria against isolated production Compose: Chromium file-tree navigation, live draft and immutable-base diffs, any-two-version history comparison, protected restore confirmation, immutable SQLite history, complete bundle and metadata read-back, downloads, current Git content, retry/permission/stale/CSRF failures, and backend restart. Focused open-mode concurrency and pending-Git-export checks plus production frontend build/lint/login/skill-action/display-name browser regressions passed. Desktop and mobile screenshots inspected. Only the Google outer identity provider was faked; no deployed instance or live external provider was changed.
